llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Animated.View sets entering={FadeInLeft.duration(400)}, a valid Reanimated entering animation.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Row container must set Reanimated `exiting={...}` animation (for example `FadeOutUp`) on `Animated.View`.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: List rendering must use stable row identity via `keyExtractor`/`key` from persistent item IDs so entering/exiting animations bind to the correct row instances.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Each Animated.View uses key={item.id} where item.id is a persistent string (e.g. 'row-1') assigned at creation and never mutated, ensuring stable row identity across renders.
evidence: nextId ref incremented to generate unique ids for new items
